atoms.text: Die meisten Modalverben können nur in der Gegenwartsform verwendet werden. Für die Zukunft oder Vergangenheit verwendet man Ersatzformen.
atoms.sound: Die meisten Mo-daal-verben können nur in der Gegenwartsform verwendet werden. Für die Zukunft oder Vergangenheit verwendet man Ersatzformen.

hint.text: Man kann die Ersatzformen auch in der Gegenwart verwenden, um einen Text abwechslungsreicher zu gestalten.

example.a: We <m-yellow>are able to</m-yellow> walk to school together.
example.sound: We are able to walk to school together.

example.a: Rosa <m-yellow>is allowed to</m-yellow> spend the night at her best friend's house.
example.b: Rosa darf bei ihrer besten Freundin übernachten.
example.sound: Rosa is allowed to spend the night at her best friend's house.
Edgar has to finish his homework.

example.a: Our aunt <m-yellow>is supposed to</m-yellow> arrive in ten minutes.
example.sound: Our aunt is supposed to arrive in ten minutes.

instruction.text: Tippe die Ersatzverben in den Sätzen an.

atoms.b: Yesterday, I ((was_supposed_to)) meet my friends at the beach.
atoms.sound: Yesterday, I was supposed to meet my friends at the beach.

atoms.b: Unfortunately, I ((wasn't_able_to)) find my football in my room.
atoms.sound: Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find my football in my room.

atoms.b: I ((wasn't_allowed_to)) borrow my brother's because he needed it himself.
atoms.sound: I wasn't allowed to borrow my brother's because he needed it himself.

atoms.b: That's why I ((had_to)) take the volleyball instead.
atoms.sound: That's why I had to take the volleyball instead.

instruction.text: Ordne den Sätzen die richtigen Ersatzformen zu.

atoms.a: He can help you with your homework.
atoms.b: ++He_is_able_to_help_you_with_your_homework. --He_is_supposed_to_help_you_with_your_homework.
atoms.sound: He is able to help you with your homework.

atoms.a: Sagan must cancel his plans for the weekend.
atoms.b: ++Sagan_has_to_cancel_his_plans_for_the_weekend. --Sagan_is_allowed_to_cancel_his_plans_for_the_weekend.
atoms.sound: Sagan has to cancel his plans for the weekend.

atoms.a: I should lend her my notes.
atoms.b: ++I_am_supposed_to_lend_her_my_notes. --I_have_to_lend_her_my_notes.
atoms.sound: I am supposed to lend her my notes.

atoms.a: Tory may go to her friend's birthday party.
atoms.b: ++Tory_is_allowed_to_go_to_her_friend's_birthday_party. --Tory_is_able_to_go_to_her_friend's_birthday_party.
atoms.sound: Tory is allowed to go to her friend's birthday party.

instruction.text: Mit welchem Verb kann man die Modalverben jeweils ersetzen? Wähle aus.
instruction.sound: Mit welchem Verb kann man die Mo-dal-verben jeweils ersetzen? Wähle aus.

hint.text: Hier sind nur die Ersatzformen für die positiven Formen der Modalverben gesucht.
